name: glucolens
description: Understand your checkup: AI search, insights and risk explorer over 100,000 checkups.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && go mod download
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && go build -o bin/glucolens-server ./cmd/server
scripts.test: cd backend && go test ./... && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && go vet ./... && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm --prefix frontend run e2e
scripts.e2e:static: node scripts/build-pages.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run e2e:static
